correctness.rationale: Proof checked: interval length κ=2(a+3)+1 contains exactly one A and 2τ complement values. Removing state offset r from 1..κ yields the explicit three-branch T_j(r), with T_j(S)⊂S={4,...,κ} for every a≥1. T_1(a+6)=a+6 ensures prolongability. Inductively defining r_(τm+j−1)=T_j(r_m) yields each complement pair B_(2τm+2j−1),B_(2τm+2j), and the recurrence exactly; uniqueness follows from greedy positive coefficients. DFAO digit transition gives base-τ automaticity. Independent direct greedy vs substitution matched first 1500 terms for a=2,3,7. No single uniform-in-a automaton claimed.
